faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services

items.q: How do I book a Hajj or Umrah package?
items.a: You can book through our website, visit our office, or contact us via WhatsApp. Our team will guide you through the complete process including visa, flights, accommodation, and Ziyarat.

items.q: What documents are required for visa processing?
items.a: Requirements vary by country but generally include a valid passport (6+ months), CNIC, photographs, bank statements, and employment letter. Contact us for country-specific requirements.
Yes! We offer special rates for group bookings on flights, tours, and Umrah packages. Contact our corporate travel desk for customized group quotes.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept bank transfers, JazzCash, Easypaisa, and credit/debit cards. Payment plans are available for select packages.

items.q: How can I apply for overseas employment through WAFA?
items.a: Browse our job listings, submit your application with required documents, and our team will guide you through the verification, interview, medical, and visa process.
